summary_en: K891 completed a tender offer for LEOPalace21, acquiring 207,044,870 shares exceeding the minimum threshold of 158,716,000 shares. Settlement begins November 9, 2026, making K891 the parent company and largest shareholder with over 50% voting rights.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Company's Securities by K891 Corporation, Changes in Parent Company and Other Related Companies, and Correction to Notice Regarding Stock Transfer Accompanied by Changes in Specific Subsidiaries
translation_en_brief:
K891 Corporation completed a tender offer for LEOPalace21 Corporation that ran from September 15 through October 30, 2026. The offer was for both common shares and certain stock acquisition rights issued by the company. A total of 207,044,870 securities were tendered, exceeding the minimum acquisition threshold of 158,716,000 shares, resulting in a successful completion of the tender offer. K891 has committed to acquiring all tendered securities.

Settlement of the tender offer will commence on November 9, 2026. Upon settlement, K891 and its direct parent K892 will become the parent company and largest shareholder of LEOPalace21, as K891's voting rights will exceed 50% of total voting rights. Additionally, Kotsushin, which is the ultimate parent of K891, will become an affiliated company under the equity method through a co-investment structure with funds managed by MBK Partners and NEC Capital Solutions.

As a result of the tender offer settlement, Chidori Godo LLC, previously an affiliated company and major shareholder, will cease to hold those positions after tendering all its LEOPalace21 shares. Similarly, UH Partners 2, the previous largest shareholder, will no longer qualify as a major shareholder.
